main_text.l: à Christo sit; certè nec licebit Magi-
eoscoërcere, quando officium suum non faciunt,
Denique ex inde aliud nihil sequitur,
seu ligare & solvere, retinere vel di-
mittere peccata: item ad eum non
sic dictam à potestate clavium: non
dinis externi circa eam, ut ea rectè
Nec etiam potest obiici[?]: per hanc
id locum habet, certè Magistratui abs-
tinendum erit etiam à cæteris parti-
bus officii sui circa res Ecclesiæ,

page.notes: Running head right-hand "Q. VII." (quaestio number) is not part of the running title and is left out. Page number "8ž" read as 82; doubtful. "eoscoërcere" printed as shown, probably "eos coërcere" with a missing space. "obiici" and "instituì" are doubtful letter forms. Stray dashes after "eum" and in the first line are printing or scan artefacts and are not transcribed. "Digitized by Google" watermark omitted.
